checks.name: Ten exact seed products, images, totals, SweetAlert2; no framework or jQuery
Instant name/code search, accent-insensitive search, combined category/stock filters and empty state
Five rows per page, numeric and previous/next navigation
Responsive table scrolling, sidebar drawer/collapse, modal and screenshots
Form validation rejects short names, zero price, fractional stock and invalid old price
Create, photo preview, success toast and persistence across reload
Edit preserves ID/date, updates price and all stock thresholds, safely renders HTML text
Deletion requires confirmation, cancel keeps data, delete last row clamps page
Two tabs refresh inventory and prevent stale form from overwriting changes
Storage write failure keeps form and existing data intact
Empty storage array remains empty after reload; malformed data is preserved with error
Dashboard, inventory and storefront links work with shared sidebar
Direct file:// opening and operation without SweetAlert CDN
